QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] The Master's Skills
QuestInfo.0: With all this training, you're filled with confidence and accustomed to life in the dojo. Time to ask the master for a training duel.
QuestInfo.1: A duel with the master! How exciting!
QuestInfo.2: His strong ki stopped you from moving even an inch. You still have a long way to go. Use this opportunity to be honest with yourself.
